sections.heading: The three ways we work
sections.intro: Most jobs fall into one of three categories. Here is roughly what each one covers.

tiers.name: Repair
tiers.goodFor: A roof that's basically sound but has a problem spot
tiers.scope: We find the specific issue, like a leak or damaged section, and fix that part of the roof without replacing the whole thing.

tiers.name: Replace
tiers.goodFor: A roof that's worn out, leaking in multiple places, or near the end of its life
tiers.scope: We remove the old roof down to the deck and install a new roofing system, matched to your home.

tiers.name: Care
tiers.goodFor: A roof and gutters that just need regular upkeep
tiers.scope: Routine gutter cleaning and a visual roof check, so small problems get caught before they become big ones.

sections.note: We don't list prices here. Ask about cost when you request your inspection.

sections.heading: How a job runs
sections.intro: From the first call to the cleanup, here's the path.

steps.title: You request an inspection
steps.text: Fill out the form with your address or suburb and a time of day that works for you.

steps.title: We take a look
steps.text: We walk the roof and gutters, take photos, and check the attic if needed.

steps.title: You get a plan
steps.text: We explain what we found and what your options are, in plain language.

steps.title: We do the work
steps.text: If you want to go ahead, we schedule the job and do the work.

steps.title: We clean up
steps.text: We haul away debris and walk you through what was done.

pages.title: Questions and Contact - Summit Line Roofing
pages.description: Common questions about roof repair, replacement and gutter work, plus the form to request your free inspection.

items.a: Yes. Request one through the form and we'll get back to you to arrange a time.

items.q: Do I need a full replacement or just a repair?
items.a: That depends on the roof. We'll tell you honestly after we take a look, not before.

items.q: Do you work on gutters without a roof job?
items.a: Yes. Gutter cleaning, repair and replacement are their own service, separate from roof work.

items.q: How do I book an inspection?
items.a: Fill out the request form with your address or suburb, what you need, and a time of day that works for you. We'll follow up from there.

items.q: What if it's an emergency, like an active leak?
items.a: Call the number listed on this site. If no one picks up, leave a message with your address and we'll call back.
